start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:deliver-a-message-as-a-row-of-my-list with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and row_type sign-in-code, to sam@example.com, subject 'Your code', text '123456', kind sign-in-code, idempotency_key k1."
no_lists_because: It names no list the person must already have: the message becomes one row of the list the store keeps for its row type, in whatever form that store keeps things.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:deliver-a-message-as-a-row-of-my-list" with store, the row type, to, subject, text, kind and an idempotency key. Send the same key again if an answer was unknown.
3. The first run makes the list's table once and proves the write on the example messages; every attempt must come out as the prove step says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run writes the message as one row through that table and reads it back.

worked_examples.title: A sign-in code written as a row
worked_examples.ask: Write a sign-in code for sam@example.com as a row of my sign-in list, text 123456, key k1.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The store keeps no sign-in-code row with key k1.
worked_examples.hands_back: outcome "written", row_id "k1", read back with to "sam@example.com" and text "123456".

worked_examples.title: The same key again writes nothing new
worked_examples.ask: Send the same sign-in code again with key k1.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The row k1 was written by the first example.
worked_examples.hands_back: outcome "repeated", row_id "k1", and still one row for k1.

worked_examples.title: A message with no address is refused
worked_examples.ask: Write a sign-in code with no address, key k3.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The store keeps the sign-in-code list.
worked_examples.hands_back: outcome "refused", row_id null, and no row written for k3.
